validation.notes: Repaired packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:451-455. DefaultResourceLoader.reload() ran the untrusted bootstrap pass (loadProjectTrustExtensions(), which forces setProjectTrusted(false) at line 438), awaited options.resolveProjectTrust(...) into the local `projectTrusted`, and then threw the decision away by calling this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(false) (line 454). Because SettingsManager.reload() (line 458) is the only place project settings are re-read for the current trust state, an explicit 'trusted' answer left project settings unloaded and project extensions/packages permanently excluded; only a false decision happened to work. The minimal fix passes the resolved value through: this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted). Untrusted bootstrap is untouched (loadProjectTrustExtensions still forces false before its reload), and the existing reload immediately before packageManager.resolve() (line 459) now reloads settings for the resolved trust state, i.e. before final resource resolution. Validation: `node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` exits 0 on the repaired tree. The regression drives the real DefaultResourceLoader.reload()/loadProjectTrustExtensions() through .prale-eval/subject.mjs boundary fakes and asserts (1) a declined trust decision is stored, reloaded and keeps project extensions out of both passes, (2) a granted trust decision is applied (state.trusted/loadedTrust true), settings are reloaded after setProjectTrusted and before the final resolve event, and the project extension is loaded into loader.getExtensions() alongside user+CLI extensions, and (3) the bootstrap pass called directly never resolves or loads project extensions. Fault detection was confirmed by temporarily restoring the original line `this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(false);`: the same script failed with AssertionError 'the resolved true decision must be stored on the settings manager' (false !== true) at regression.mjs:78, then passed again after re-applying the one-line fix (git diff shows exactly 1 insertion / 1 deletion). Limitation: no npm dependencies are installed in this workspace (node_modules is absent), so the repository's vitest suite (e.g. packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts 'should load user extensions before trust and reuse them after trust resolves', which asserts the same behavior) could not be executed; validation relies on the dependency-free Node 24 regression script and the hidden production-behavior oracle.

claims.claim: The explicit trusted decision was ignored after bootstrap: reload() unconditionally set project trust to false instead of using the resolved value.
Settings must be reloaded for the resolved trust state before final resource resolution.
Project extensions must stay excluded during the untrusted bootstrap pass.
Regression exercises the repaired production lifecycle with boundary fakes and asserts true/false decisions plus bootstrap exclusion.
